name: albumin

function.text: ALB encodes albumin. Annotated molecular activities include antioxidant activity and molecular carrier activity. It participates in heme biosynthetic process and heme catabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital analbuminemia (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

selection_reason: Panel membership; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.

editorial.author: Codex — source-grounded annotation draft
editorial.change_note: Initial structured-annotation draft; requires specialist review of wording, allele mechanism, and disease applicability.

function.text: ALB encodes albumin. Based in part on similarity, major zinc transporter in plasma, typically binds about 80% of all plasma zinc. Major calcium and magnesium transporter in plasma, binds approximately 45% of circulating calcium and magnesium in plasma. Potentially has more than two calcium-binding sites and might additionally bind calcium in a non-specific manner.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital analbuminemia (autosomal recessive).
